source.handler: handleXiaomiMimoSpeech: POST { model, messages: [{ role: assistant, content: input }], audio: { format: mp3|wav, voice: voice || providerSpecificData.defaultVoice || mimo_default } } with Content-Type application/json + Authorization Bearer; audio/* answer streamed, JSON answer read from choices[0].message.audio.data (then the getXiaomiMimoAudioData fallbacks), decoded with atob; other response_format refused with 400 before the upstream call

checked: open-sse/providers/registry/xiaomi-mimo.js (chat provider id xiaomi-mimo, aliases [mimo, mimo-desktop, xmd], authModes [oauth, apikey]; chat transports only: no serviceKinds tts, no ttsConfig, no tts model row)
open-sse/providers/registry/xiaomi-mimo-token-plan.js (separate provider id xiaomi-mimo-token-plan, serviceKinds [llm], no tts rows)

open-sse/providers/registry/xiaomi-tokenplan.js (separate provider id xiaomi-tokenplan, tp- keys on token-plan-<region>.xiaomimimo.com; lists mimo-v2.5-tts / -voiceclone / -voicedesign with kind tts but has no ttsConfig and no TTS_ADAPTERS entry, so handleTtsCore answers 400 'does not support TTS via this route' before any network call; not the source xiaomi-mimo speech entry and not activated here)
open-sse/handlers/ttsProviders/index.js TTS_ADAPTERS (no xiaomi-mimo or alias entry)
open-sse/executors/xiaomi-mimo.js (chat executor; account-session route on mimo-server-<region> is chat-only)
src/shared/constants/ttsProviders.js and src/sse/handlers/tts.js (no xiaomi-mimo speech UI config or named-format entry)
localEquivalence.result: no local equivalent: the provider and both connection modes exist, the speech route does not; this module is the speech delta, reusing the existing connection's API key

exports.xiaomiMimoTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options)
exports.createXiaomiMimoTtsAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxAudioBytes } for tests
exports.discoverXiaomiMimoTtsModels: (credentials, { fetchImpl, signal, timeoutMs }) -> { models, source: api|local_catalog, status? }; never throws
exports.buildXiaomiMimoSpeechRequest: (model, text, options, { format, defaultVoice }) -> source body; throws status 400 for any field the source would drop
exports.normalizeXiaomiMimoRequestFormat: source format aliases (plus json) -> mp3 | wav | null
exports.isXiaomiMimoTtsModelId: static row or catalog id matching XIAOMI_MIMO_TTS_MODEL_PATTERN
exports.xiaomiMimoAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.XIAOMI_MIMO_TTS_PROVIDER_ADDITIONS: staged additions to the existing xiaomi-mimo registry entry (serviceKinds, model rows, ttsConfig)
exports.XIAOMI_MIMO_TTS_CONFIG: ttsConfig block { baseUrl, authType, authHeader, format, supportedFormats, defaultVoice, models }
exports.XIAOMI_MIMO_TTS_MODEL_PATTERN: speech-model id pattern used to filter the live catalog

provider.accountSessionConnections: refused with 401 before submit when the connection has no apiKey; accessToken and providerSpecificData.mimoPassToken are never sent to the speech API

models.voiceSuffix: refused: the source takes the voice from the voice field (default from providerSpecificData.defaultVoice, then mimo_default)
models.dynamicDiscovery: GET https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1/models with the connection key; ids matching XIAOMI_MIMO_TTS_MODEL_PATTERN only; static rows on any failure

speech.body: { model, messages: [{ role: "assistant", content: input }], audio: { format: "mp3" | "wav", voice } }
speech.answer: application/json chat-completions envelope with base64 audio, or an audio/* body
